description: This file defines the du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng class, which manages aperiodic SRS resources in a DU (Distributed Unit) for 5G NR, including resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration for UEs within the network.

classes.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng
classes.description: Manages aperiodic SRS resources for a DU, handling resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration for UEs.

classes.name: cell_context
classes.description: Holds per-cell SRS resource configurations and state, including resource list, usage, and slot offset.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates an SRS resource to a UE based on policy: unallocated resources first, then least used.

methods.name: dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates SRS resources for a given cell group configuration.

methods.name: get_du_srs_res_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the SRS resource configuration for a given cell resource ID.

methods.name: fill_srs_res_parameters
methods.description: Fills in parameters for a specific SRS resource for a UE.

methods.name: fill_srs_res_set
methods.description: Fills the SRS resource set list for a UE configuration.
